description.zh: 一组表情符号卡片短暂闪现后藏起来，孩子从选项里找出刚才看到的那一张。K1-G2 从两张、干扰项来自完全不同类别，逐步过渡到五张、干扰项来自同一类别。训练的是短时间接触后的视觉再认，而不是持续观察。
description.en: A handful of emoji cards flash briefly, then hide; the child picks the one they saw from the options. K1-G2 goes from two cards with distractors from an unrelated category, up to five cards with lookalike distractors from the same category. What it trains is visual recognition after a brief exposure, not ongoing observation.

designModel.zh: 主轴是展示卡数（item_count）与展示时长（exposure_ms），配合选项相似度（option_similarity：跨类别更容易，同类别更容易混淆）。三轴共同决定记忆负荷。
designModel.en: The primary axes are card count (item_count) and exposure time (exposure_ms), paired with option similarity (option_similarity: cross-category is easier, same-category is more confusable). The three axes together set the memory load.

cognitiveChain.noteZh: 当前玩法主要覆盖观察、短时保持与再认提取；编码只来自同类别卡片带来的自然分组，尚未要求儿童主动组织信息。
cognitiveChain.noteEn: The current play mainly covers observation, short-term retention and recognition retrieval. Encoding is only implicit in the natural category grouping; the child is not yet asked to organize the information actively.

ageRange.noteZh: K1 两张卡、展示 3 秒适合 3-4 岁；G2 五张卡、同类别干扰、展示 1.6 秒约 7 岁。
ageRange.noteEn: K1's two cards shown for 3s suit ages 3-4; G2's five cards with same-category distractors shown for 1.6s suit about age 7.

seriesBoundary.policyZh: 本模块属小精灵系列 · 记忆守护者。训练的是『看过之后凭记忆回答』，卡片消失后才能作答；与 difference-scout（找不同侦探）不同，后者两侧图列全程可见，训练的是当下持续比较，不涉及延迟回忆。
seriesBoundary.policyEn: This module belongs to MindSeeds · Memory Guardian. It trains recall after the cards are gone — answering is only possible once they hide. This differs from difference-scout, whose two strips stay visible throughout; that module trains ongoing comparison, not delayed recall.

geneReporting.ruleZh: 每次 Attempt 上报 RG.MEMORY.VISUAL.RECOGNITION，不随等级变化。
geneReporting.ruleEn: Every attempt reports RG.MEMORY.VISUAL.RECOGNITION, regardless of grade.

difficultyAxes.noteZh: 每次闪现的卡片数量，从两张到五张。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: The number of cards that flash at once, from two up to five.

difficultyAxes.noteZh: 卡片可见的时间：K1 约 3 秒，G2 约 1.6 秒。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: How long the cards stay visible: about 3s at K1, about 1.6s at G2.

difficultyAxes.noteZh: low 干扰项来自不同类别（一眼可排除）；mixed 混合来自同类或跨类；high 干扰项全部来自同一类别，需要真的记住细节。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: low draws distractors from an unrelated category (easy to rule out at a glance); mixed draws from either; high draws all distractors from the same category, requiring the child to actually recall the specific card.

sessionPolicy.noteZh: 一次 8 题，通过线 75%（6/8）。没有静态题库：generator.js 现生成，玩完立即换一批。
sessionPolicy.noteEn: Eight items per run, passing at 75% (6/8). No static bank: generator.js builds each set and a new one is swapped in when the run ends.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 两张卡片闪现 3 秒，从跨类别的选项里找出看到的那张。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Two cards flash for 3s; find the one you saw among cross-category options.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 三张卡片闪现 2.5 秒，选项仍来自不同类别。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Three cards flash for 2.5s; options still come from an unrelated category.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 四张卡片闪现 2 秒，干扰项可能来自同类别或不同类别。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Four cards flash for 2s; distractors may come from either the same or a different category.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 五张卡片闪现 1.6 秒，干扰项全部来自同一类别，最容易混淆。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Five cards flash for 1.6s; distractors all come from the same category, the most confusable.

statistics.noteZh: optionTypes 区分 seen（看过）、same_category（同类干扰）与 other_category（跨类干扰），能看出错误是猜测还是被相似项混淆。
statistics.noteEn: optionTypes separate seen, same_category and other_category, showing whether an error was a guess or confusion with a lookalike.
